checks.what: EDF files that could not be decoded are listed in the README

differences: All 109 EDF files in the deposit (41 ASD, 68 TD) were decoded and none is left out. The paper states a sampling rate of 1,000 Hz, but the EDF files are recorded at 500 Hz (sample_rate_hz of each row).
Two participants recruited into the autism group were excluded from the paper's analysis; the deposit does not say which, so no participant is flagged.
The paper's saccade amplitudes were extracted by the authors' own MATLAB script, which is not in the deposit, so no amplitude statistic was re-derived.
